Bind that verified auxiliary source identity to innistrad_exile_at_end_of_combat_legacy, which performs the recovered native exile/legacy cleanup behavior. Exact source replay changes one callback expression in the original commander_2015.c function. Native/rebuilt token76-byte geometry, four-byte int(int,int,event-enum) callback pointer shape, callback COFF identity and store are checked. Every other direct scalar byte-event multiset is retained; this does not prove all dynamic token values, transitive helper behavior or gameplay.
